chris-release: Final sweep — change window opens in 28m. Quick checklist: are model pins applied? rollback playbook up-to-date? canaries scheduled? release notes published? link: https://redwood.internal/releases/18876

maria-dev: Pins applied to prod-config v2.7.1 -> pinned stable model: redwood-llama-7b-q4_0

alex-enginfra: Autoscaler policy set, burst enabled, GC disabled during window. config snippet:
```
deployment:
  pins:
    model: redwood-llama-7b-q4_0
  rollout: canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100%
```

sre-oncall: Rollback playbook verified. Ops runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/rollback
sre-oncall: I have a hotfix branch ready if vault auth fails. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary started on datacenter-us-east-1 · asg-canary-3
deploy-bot: Canary health: 98% success, avg latency +3ms

tim-qa: Ran smoke on canary, saw a 502 spike on long requests at 2m mark, attributed to timeout(8s) -> increased to 12s in staging. Monitoring alert rule updated.

jenna-product: Release notes posted. small note: behavior change in response tokens truncation — called out in docs. https://docs.redwood/product/releases/18876

chris-release: Approvals: @sre-oncall, @alex-enginfra — please :eyes: if you can give explicit go for 30m mark.

sre-oncall: I sign off, will watch alerts. :white_check_mark:

alex-enginfra: Sign off from infra. I'll be on call for 1hr after rollout. :rocket:

maria-dev: Tagging shas: backend @ abc123, model-config @ def456. Exported rollout plan to deploy-bot queue.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window at 2026-03-20T15:00:00Z, changewindow-id cw-20260320-9

tim-qa: Leaving a rapid test checklist:
- smoke generate on pages
- embedding regression check with sample corpus
- latency SLO probe

chris-release: OK. final note: if rollback needed use `rollback playbook v2` and pin back to redwood-llama-7b-q3_vintage. Notify #incidents and paging SRE.

jenna-product: I'll update release banner in app after golden is 100%. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary -> canary->canary progression complete: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Full rollout triggered.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed at 2026-03-20T15:12:21Z. No post-deploy critical alerts so far.

sre-oncall: Monitoring green. No errors >5xx in last 10m. closing watch in 20m.

chris-release: Thanks everyone — great coordinated run. We'll keep the quiet window for 2h. :tada:
